title: Have Blue prototype owned by Lockheed Skunk Works despite Air Force markings

tellings.quote: when it was uh have blue and it was the preliminary designs, the US Air Force did not own that even though it had US Air Force markings.

plain: In the 1970s, the story goes, the early designs of Have Blue, a secret experimental aircraft programme, did not belong to the US Air Force even though the plane carried Air Force markings. Instead they belonged to Lockheed's Skunk Works, the company's secret aircraft design shop. Greg Rogers, a former NASA doctor, tells Michels this as something a person he knew passed on to him. If true, it would mean a private company, not the military, owned what looked like a military aircraft.
